scope: Proposition 5.14 (The bounded clearing factor for the family) of the manuscript “A pointwise 2-converse for elliptic curves with rational two-torsion” (preprints/A-pointwise-2-converse-for-elliptic-curves-with-rational-two-torsion-October-7-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 004 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 df42f33f68fbef77), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 45. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume the compatible universal Selmer and Heegner diagrams and their primitive specializations. Suppose every character constituent of the universal Selmer complex is generically acyclic or has generic cohomology of dimension one in degrees one and two and zero elsewhere. If the fixed base has 2∞-Selmer corank one over K, the corrected coordinates of Lemma 5.11 admit the factorization (5.30), with central valuation and fixed-precision pole bounds independent of b and #Q.
